stories.headline: AI chips push everything else off TSMC's most advanced N3 production lines

key_facts.fact: In 2026, Nvidia's Rubin, Google's TPU v7/v8, Amazon's Trainium3, and AMD's MI350X are all simultaneously migrating to TSMC's N3 process, with utilization expected to exceed 100% in H2 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: In 2026, Nvidia, Google, Amazon, and AMD are all moving their AI accelerators to TSMC's N3 process at the same time.

key_facts.fact: AI-related wafers account for just under 60% of N3 output in 2026, projected to reach 86% by 2027, according to SemiAnalysis.
key_facts.excerpt: AI wafers are expected to account for around 86 percent of N3 capacity by 2027.

key_facts.fact: HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) consumes roughly three times more wafer capacity per bit than standard DRAM, with ratios potentially widening to nearly 4x with HBM4 adoption.
key_facts.excerpt: Memory is also scarce. HBM consumes roughly three times more wafer capacity per bit than standard DRAM, and with HBM4 that ratio gets even worse.

key_facts.fact: TSMC drastically underestimated AI demand timing — its capital expenditure didn't exceed its previous peak until 2025, despite the major compute buildout beginning in late 2022. The company won't add sufficient capacity for at least two more years.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC has been caught flat-footed, with wafer capacity expansion falling well behind surging AI demand.

key_facts.fact: Weakening smartphone demand is freeing up capacity that gets redirected to AI chips. Reallocating just 25% of smartphone N3 wafer starts could enable roughly 700,000 additional Rubin GPUs or 1.5 million additional TPU v7s.
key_facts.excerpt: Weakening smartphone demand is freeing up capacity that gets redirected straight to AI chips.

stories.headline: NVIDIA previews CPU pivot for agentic AI and Feynman architecture ahead of GTC 2026

key_facts.fact: NVIDIA showed CNBC its Vera CPU at its Santa Clara headquarters, framing CPUs as 'becoming the bottleneck' in agentic AI workflows where tool processing on CPUs can account for up to 90.6% of total latency.
key_facts.excerpt: Central processing units (CPUs) are having a renaissance, and Nvidia says they're 'becoming the bottleneck' amid surging agentic AI workflows.

key_facts.fact: The Rubin platform integrates six specialized chips into a unified AI supercomputer — Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, ConnectX-9 SuperNIC, Spectrum-6 Ethernet Switch, and BlueField-4 DPU — promising up to 10x reduction in inference token cost.
key_facts.excerpt: up to 10x reduction in inference token cost and 4x reduction in number of GPUs to train MoE models.

key_facts.fact: NVIDIA struck a multiyear deal with Meta for large-scale Grace CPU deployments, with Vera planned for 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia has struck a multiyear deal with Meta for large-scale Grace CPU deployments, with Vera planned for 2027.

key_facts.fact: NVIDIA's next-gen Feynman GPU architecture will be built on TSMC's A16 (1.6nm) process with backside power delivery, expected to exceed 1,000W TDP per card and target 2028 data center availability.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC A16 (1.6nm class) with Super Power Rail (SPR) backside power delivery... Single-Card TDP: Expected to exceed 1,000W.

key_facts.fact: CNBC reported NVIDIA invested roughly $20 billion in the technology underpinning its upcoming new AI chip, with the GTC 2026 keynote scheduled for March 16 in San Jose.
key_facts.excerpt: A closer look at Nvidia's $20 billion bet on tech for a new AI chip.

stories.headline: Foundation's Phantom MK-1 humanoid robots begin battlefield evaluation in Ukraine

key_facts.fact: Two Phantom MK-1 humanoid robots from US company Foundation were delivered to Ukraine in February 2026 and are being evaluated for military use, marking one of the first real-world battlefield deployments of humanoid soldier technology.
key_facts.excerpt: Ukraine has received two humanoid Phantom MK-1 soldier robots from the U.S.-based company Foundation to evaluate their potential use on the battlefield.

key_facts.fact: The robots are being tested for resupply missions and reconnaissance in areas drones cannot access, including bunkers and confined spaces. Tests are also planned with the U.S. Marine Corps for breaching operations.
key_facts.excerpt: Humanoid soldiers could be invaluable for resupplying and reconnaissance, especially in places drones cannot reach.

key_facts.fact: Foundation holds $24 million in research contracts with the U.S. Army, Navy, and Air Force. The robots are also being assessed for Homeland Security border patrol applications.
key_facts.excerpt: $24 million in research contracts with U.S. Army, Navy, and Air Force.

key_facts.fact: The upcoming MK-2 model, set to debut in April, will carry loads up to 80 kg with improved waterproofing and larger batteries. The robots are designed to operate any weapon a human can use.
key_facts.excerpt: Upcoming MK-2 model (April debut) will carry loads up to 80 kg with improved waterproofing and larger batteries.

key_facts.fact: Current limitations include frequent recharging needs, balance failures during demonstrations, vulnerability to hacking, and AI 'hallucination' errors in decision-making.
key_facts.excerpt: Heavy, expensive systems requiring frequent recharging. Prone to balance failures; robots fell multiple times during demonstrations.

stories.headline: SpaceX launches 54 Starlink satellites from both US coasts within 37 minutes

key_facts.fact: SpaceX executed a same-day dual-launch on March 13, with Falcon 9 rockets lifting off from Vandenberg (7:33 AM PDT, 25 satellites) and Cape Canaveral (8:10 AM EDT, 29 satellites) within 37 minutes of each other.
key_facts.excerpt: Falcon 9 rockets lifting off from both coasts within 37 minutes of each other — deploying 54 Starlink satellites in a single morning.

key_facts.fact: These were the 26th and 27th Starlink missions of 2026, pushing the constellation to 9,949 satellites in orbit with 9,938 operational.
key_facts.excerpt: With 9,938 satellites currently operational out of 9,949 in orbit, the two launches will push the active fleet even deeper into uncharted density territory.

key_facts.fact: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr publicly criticized Amazon on social media for opposing SpaceX's latest satellite plan, signaling regulatory momentum favoring SpaceX's expansion.
key_facts.excerpt: FCC Chair Brendan Carr publicly rebuked Amazon for opposing SpaceX's latest satellite plan, injecting fresh tension.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX has now launched a total of 11,488 Starlink satellites to date. Two high-risk conjunction events were identified in March 2026, with minimum ranges of 0.002 km and 0.008 km.
key_facts.excerpt: Two HIGH-risk conjunction events identified in March 2026, with minimum ranges of 0.002 km and 0.008 km respectively.

stories.headline: NASA Artemis 2 clears flight readiness review, targets April 1 moon launch

key_facts.fact: NASA completed a two-day flight readiness review on March 12 with all teams polling 'go', setting April 1 at 6:24 PM ET as the target launch date for the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
key_facts.excerpt: NASA currently plans to roll the Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft from the Vehicle Assembly Building back to Launch Complex 39B on March 19. That would set up a launch as soon as April 1.

key_facts.fact: The SLS rocket had been rolled back to the Vehicle Assembly Building on February 25 after a seal in a quick-disconnect helium line came loose, blocking helium flow to the upper stage. Engineers removed the problematic seal and reinforced another.
key_facts.excerpt: An investigation found that a seal in a quick-disconnect, or QD, line between ground equipment and the stage had come loose, blocking the flow of helium in the line.

key_facts.fact: The mission will send four astronauts — three Americans and one Canadian — on a nine-to-ten day trip around the moon without landing, including viewing parts of the far side that Apollo astronauts never witnessed.
key_facts.excerpt: The agency is now aiming to launch the historic mission, called Artemis II, on April 1 as soon as 6:24 p.m. ET.

key_facts.fact: NASA will not conduct another wet dress rehearsal before launch. The launch window extends through April 6, with an additional opportunity on April 30.
key_facts.excerpt: The launch window runs through April 6.

stories.headline: Hyundai's Motional relaunches robotaxi service on Uber in Las Vegas after 2024 reset

key_facts.fact: Motional's self-driving Ioniq 5 vehicles became available on the Uber app in Las Vegas on March 13, serving five zones including Resorts World, Encore, Westgate, Town Square, and Downtown Las Vegas.
key_facts.excerpt: Hyundai-owned Motional's self-driving version of the Ioniq 5 is now available to be hailed for rides to and from five areas around the city.

key_facts.fact: The relaunch comes two years after Motional paused all commercial operations, cut roughly 40% of its workforce, and nearly collapsed when co-founder Aptiv pulled its funding.
key_facts.excerpt: Two years ago paused its commercial operations entirely, cut roughly 40% of its workforce, and was left fighting for its survival after co-founder Aptiv pulled its funding.

key_facts.fact: The service initially operates with a human safety monitor in the vehicle. Motional expects to begin fully driverless service by end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: With a safety monitor in the car, for now... they expect to be able to run a fully driverless service in Las Vegas by the end of this year.

key_facts.fact: Riders requesting UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort may be matched with a Motional Ioniq 5 at no additional cost, with the option to accept or switch to a conventional ride.
key_facts.excerpt: Riders who request an UberX, Uber Electric, Uber Comfort, or Uber Comfort Electric may be matched with a Motional IONIQ 5 at no additional cost.

stories.headline: Google announces $1 billion expansion of its Lenoir, North Carolina data center

key_facts.fact: Google will invest more than $1 billion over two years to expand its data center campus in Lenoir, North Carolina, which has been operating since 2007 and currently employs 400 people.
key_facts.excerpt: Google will invest more than $1 billion over two years to grow existing data center infrastructure in Lenoir.

key_facts.fact: Google has already invested more than $1.2 billion in North Carolina and generated $13.1 billion in economic activity in the state in 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: Google generated $13.1 billion in economic activity in North Carolina in 2024. It has invested $1.2 billion in the state since the company built the data center.

key_facts.fact: The expansion follows Google's $600 million investment in the same facility announced in 2024, which came with city and county performance-based incentive grants of 50% real property and 85% personal property over 20 years.
key_facts.excerpt: In 2024, Google announced a $600 million investment that came with city and county incentives.

key_facts.fact: The investment comes as North Carolina becomes a hotbed for data center expansion amid surging AI demand, but also faces rising opposition from residents concerned about energy usage.
key_facts.excerpt: North Carolina is becoming a hot bed for data center expansion amid a massive surge in demand fueled by AI usage. But there's also been a rise of opposition by residents concerned about their energy usage.

stories.headline: Elroy Air selected for DOT's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program with autonomous cargo drone

key_facts.fact: Elroy Air was selected for the US Department of Transportation's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP), a federal initiative to test and scale next-generation aviation technologies launched under the 'Unleashing American Drone Dominance' executive order.
key_facts.excerpt: Elroy Air has been selected for the US Department of Transportation's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) — a government initiative designed to help regulators and industry partners test and scale next-generation aviation technologies.

key_facts.fact: Elroy Air is the only manufacturer in the program offering a purpose-built heavy-payload cargo drone rather than a passenger aircraft. Its Chaparral autonomous cargo VTOL is designed for 'middle-mile' logistics with a 300-mile range.
key_facts.excerpt: Elroy Air stands out for a different reason: its aircraft is built entirely for cargo... the only manufacturer in the program offering a purpose-built heavy-payload cargo drone rather than a passenger aircraft.

key_facts.fact: The Chaparral drone is designed for movement of goods between distribution hubs, ports, and remote facilities, betting that autonomous cargo flights face less regulatory complexity than passenger-carrying vehicles.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's Chaparral autonomous cargo VTOL drone is designed specifically for 'middle-mile' logistics — the movement of goods between distribution hubs, ports, and remote facilities.
